narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000007 — THE ABYSSAL SERVER HALL

Deep blue dark, humming racks for walls — pressure at crushing depth.

Tonight the dome hosts Barista x Yoga Guide (hybrid) against Card Trick Tutor (domain). Judging: The Engineer's Rubric. The mission: "Write a weather report for a planet with two suns." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Barista x Yoga Guide counters a lightning analogy (61.8 pts). Card Trick Tutor unleashes a precision strike of clarity (74.3 pts). Round to Card Trick Tutor.

ROUND 2: Barista x Yoga Guide counters a precision strike of clarity (59.6 pts). Card Trick Tutor presses the attack a feint of pure logic (61.8 pts). Round to Card Trick Tutor.

ROUND 3: Barista x Yoga Guide detonates a gambit of wit (54 pts). Card Trick Tutor steadies a volley of reasoning (68 pts). Round to Card Trick Tutor.

FINAL: Card Trick Tutor defeats Barista x Yoga Guide, 204.1 to 175.4 — a margin of 28.7 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Robustness. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Card Trick Tutor won on The Engineer's Rubric with a 28.7-point margin (204.1 vs 175.4).
Strongest dimension: Robustness — Card Trick Tutor's robustness carried all three rounds.
Card Trick Tutor was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Barista x Yoga Guide against a pure system contender to isolate the robustness gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Engineer's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Correctness 35%, Robustness 25%, Elegance 20%, Completeness 20%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000007, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Card Trick Tutor's robustness-first drill for "Write a weather report for a planet with t"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on robustness when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Card Trick Tutor's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000007: isolate robustness, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
